summary.headline: APDerm captures $1.18 M in annual savings across 12 indirect spend categories
summary.narrative: Through a two-phase strategic sourcing engagement, Treya Partners delivered $1.18 million in verified annual savings for Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm). Six categories—ranging from Medical Supplies to Janitorial Services—are already locked in and producing $0.86 million in yearly benefit, while another six categories representing $0.32 million are in final review or active implementation. Savings were created via competitive RFPs, GPO leverage and incumbent renegotiations, with most awards retaining incumbent suppliers to ensure seamless execution.

impact.operational_improvements: Established centralized supply agreements across 30+ locations, locked 12-month price holds on core medical products, and introduced data-driven vendor performance tracking for janitorial and copier fleets.

proof_points.statement: “APDerm’s agreement with McKesson was fully executed on July 30, 2021 – estimated savings were 27% ($485K).”
“Treya has received revised bid from Enterprise, the current majority incumbent, with an improved hourly rate resulting in $193K savings.”
“Athena pricing reduced from 1.80% to 1.50%, delivering $259,800 in annual savings (17%).”

extraction_sources: Project Updates/Weekly Leadership Updates 2/APDerm Strategic Sourcing Project Update (090721).pptx
extraction_notes: Only categories with clear RFPs, executed contracts, or quantified savings were included.
Savings figures use low-end estimates where a range was provided to maintain conservatism.
Categories such as Employee Benefits and IT Managed Services were excluded from savings totals because no monetary benefit had been finalized.
